meta.note: Conventions reflect observed tendencies rather than strict machine-wide enforcement rules.

principles: choose locations using actual existing machine conventions
avoid unnecessary duplicate runtimes or package managers
consider downstream relationships before moving or replacing tools
record exceptions when a tool intentionally uses a non-default path

directory_roles.role: development infrastructure, global tools and SDKs

drive_tendencies.tendency: productivity / heavy installed tools, CAD/3D, relatively important local data
flexible storage, user development projects, global tools and SDKs
